parameters.name: delim
parameters.description: Delimiter to be used instead of " " (space). Only used when state=value_present or state=value_absent. Default: " "

parameters.name: jail
parameters.description: Name or ID of the jail to operate on.

parameters.name: name
parameters.description: Name of variable in /etc/rc.conf to manage.

parameters.name: path
parameters.description: Path to file to use instead of /etc/rc.conf. Default: "/etc/rc.conf"

parameters.name: state
parameters.description: Use present to add the variable. Use absent to remove the variable. Use value_present to add the value to the existing variable. Use value_absent to remove the value from the existing variable. Choices: "absent" "present" ← (default) "value_present" "value_absent"

parameters.name: value
parameters.description: The value to set when state=present. The value to add when state=value_present. The value to remove when state=value_absent.

examples:
# enable mysql in the /etc/rc.conf
- name: Configure mysql pid file
  community.general.sysrc:
    name: mysql_pidfile
    value: "/var/run/mysqld/mysqld.pid"

# enable accf_http kld in the boot loader
- name: Enable accf_http kld
  community.general.sysrc:
    name: accf_http_load
    state: present
    value: "YES"
    path: /boot/loader.conf

# add gif0 to cloned_interfaces
- name: Add gif0 interface
  community.general.sysrc:
    name: cloned_interfaces
    state: value_present
    value: "gif0"

# enable nginx on a jail
- name: Enable nginx in test jail
  community.general.sysrc:
    name: nginx_enable
    value: "YES"
    jail: testjail
